project.description: The name of the project to make publishable

formats.description: The bundle formats the package builds, among esm, cjs, iife and umd (e.g., 'esm,cjs,iife,umd')

globalName.description: Global variable name for iife and umd bundles (e.g., 'AcmeMyUtils'). Defaults to the scope and the name as one class name.

bundleEntry.description: Entry point for iife and umd bundles (e.g., '.' or './browser')

keywords.description: npm keywords for the package. Defaults to the package's own, else its name, its scope and 'typescript'.

nodeEngine.description: The Node.js range the package declares (e.g., '>=20.0.0'). Defaults to the package's own, else '>=18.0.0'.

buildExecutor.description: The executor of the build target

e2eDirectory.description: The directory the e2e project is created under
